Records without settings identity cannot independently prove optimizer selection; this is a pre-existing evidence limit, not a newly confirmed wrong optimizer run.
F03 corrected manual controls explicitly record EnableNewRBO=false and retain their source/guard observations, but omit a full settings hash in their summary.
New-only evidence is not invalidated by this audit.
